content:
Anjali: Heads up — I kicked off a 5% canary for model v3.2-int4 on staging to validate quantized perf. Monitoring A/B now, pinging @kevin for targeted evals.
Kevin: Got it. Quick smoke: P95 latency +12ms, cost per token down ~18%. Ran the small fidelity slice — factuality_exact down 1.9% so far on sampled queries.
Liam: Reminder: current auto-fallback config uses absolute_delta_pct = 2.0 on fidelity metrics with a 30m window.
Sara: Also seeing short-hallucination rate +0.8% on the QA slice (still under 1%).
Anjali: 1.9% is borderline. Proposal: hold at 5% traffic and run the targeted eval for another 60m. If factuality_exact delta >= 2.0% AND p-value < 0.01 then trigger auto-fallback.
Kevin: Suggest tightening: require BOTH abs_delta >= 2.0% AND one of (rolling z-score >= 2.5 OR p < 0.01) to avoid noisy flaps on small slices.
Liam: Also add min_samples = 2000 to the rule so we don't act on tiny N. And add hysteresis: once fallback occurs, lock promotion for 2h.
Anjali: Agree. Pasting current rollout snippet for clarity:
```json
{"canary": {"traffic_pct": 5, "metrics": ["factuality_exact","latency_p95"], "auto_fallback": {"metric": "factuality_exact", "direction": "down", "absolute_delta_pct": 2.0, "window_mins": 30}}}
```
ci-bot: Canary started: v3.2-int4 -> 5% traffic. id=canary-1746054321
Kevin: Running eval runner now against longform-factset and QA-slice. Will push results in ~45m.
ci-bot: Canary metric snapshot (t=30m): latency_p95 +12ms, cost -18%, factuality_exact delta -2.2%, p=0.007, samples=2340
Liam: Snapshot looks past the thresholds (abs delta > 2.0 and p < 0.01). Per config that should auto-fallback. Do we want to wait for another window?
Anjali: Rollback now. Manual override given p-value and sample size. Initiating rollback to v3.1.
deploy-bot: rollback started for canary-1746054321 -> target v3.1
deploy-bot: rollback complete, traffic restored to v3.1 baseline.
Sara: Noted. Creating a post-rollback checklist: (1) run quant calibration on longform-factset, (2) expand sensitivity slices, (3) tweak canary rules as discussed.
Anjali: Filed INF-2381 with checklist and links to eval runs. Action items: @Liam update rollout config with min_samples + hysteresis; @Kevin re-run longer eval after calibration.
Kevin: On it. I'll also add the z-score calc to the eval pipeline so the decision rule is reproducible.
Liam: I'll push a config PR to infra with the new auto-fallback json and a short runbook entry.
Anjali: Thanks all. Lesson: quant gains on cost + latency but we need stronger slice-aware fidelity checks before promoting beyond 5%. :eyes:
